newsitem.title: USA: CEA LAB to sell some assets to Auburn.
newsitem.headline: CEA LAB to sell some assets to Auburn.

text.p: CEA LAB Inc said Tuesday it plans to sell the assets of its Fifth Avenue Communications unit to Auburn Equities Inc for $250,000 in cash and 1.25 million of Auburn's restricted common shares.

CEA LAB said the transaction requres the approval of the board of both companies in addition to Auburn's shareholders. Auburn will change its name to Fifth Avenue Communications Inc once the deal closes in late March, CEA LAB said.
CEA LAB is a holding company with operations in a variety of industries, a spokeswoman said.
